question: to the Commission Kathleen Funchion (The Left) Subject:

Will the Commission outline if there are any incompatibilities between the draft of Ireland’s Island Fisheries (Heritage Licence) Bill 2017 and EU law under the common fisheries policy and, if so, point out exactly where such incompatibilities occur?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (29.6.2026) According to information available on the website of the Houses of the Oireachtas1, the draft bill referred to by the Honourable Member lapsed following the dissolution of the Dáil and was never adopted. In these circumstances, any assessment of its compatibility with EU law would therefore be purely hypothetical. Nevertheless, the Commission as guardian of the Treaties will continue to actively monitor the application of EU law.
